summary: Lumbar MRI for 3 weeks of uncomplicated back pain, requested for reassurance

request.clinical_notes: 30-year-old software engineer with low back pain for 3 weeks after starting a new gym program. No leg pain, no numbness, no weakness, no bowel or bladder symptoms, no fever, no trauma. Neurological exam normal. Has used ibuprofen as needed for a week. He is worried something is seriously wrong and is asking for an MRI to be reassured. Advised heat and stretching; physical therapy referral placed but not started.
